$comment: Machine-readable governance for .qoder/hooks/flowgate.sh. Values mirror AGENTS.md; AGENTS.md stays the human source of truth.

git.$comment: AGENTS.md forbids autonomous staging, committing and pushing. Prefix a command with FLOWGATE_GIT_APPROVED=1 only after the user explicitly approved it.
git.$comment_flags: --dry-run cannot change state, so it is never a human-in-the-loop action.

limits.$comment: AGENTS.md: File < 800 lines. Checked on the file as written, for the extensions in checks.lengthExempt's complement.

checks.$comment_grandfathered: 938 lines, above the 800 limit. Exempted on 2026-11-05 so the gate does not block every edit; split it when the simulator is next restructured.

swiftParse.$comment: xcrun swiftc -parse on the single edited file: catches syntax damage in well under a second. Whole-target typecheck and tests belong to CI (macos-15 workflow). Scoped to the two app targets because standalone scripts under scripts/ legitimately use top-level code, which -parse rejects.

i18nKeyParity.$comment: A key added to one locale and not the other silently renders blank or English on /vi. That was the main defect of the web-i18n branch.
